name: Blindness Spiritual
overview: Spiritual blindness is depicted in Scripture as a condition where the heart and understanding are darkened, resulting in alienation from God and a failure to glorify Him despite clear evidence of His eternal power and divine nature in creation. This blindness, described as a work of the devil and a consequence of sin and unbelief, leads to vain imaginations and hardness of heart, causing individuals to walk in the vanity of their minds and indulge in sinful desires. Christ is appointed to remove this blindness, and His ministers serve as lights to guide people out of this darkness, reflecting the need for prayer and reliance on God's intervention for deliverance from spiritual blindness.
